svg.title: South Ferry
svg.desc: Interpretive hand-authored study after visual inspection of the1996 Guggenheim retrospective plate. Approximate geometry; standardized vivid palette. Texture, mounting shadows and perspective omitted. Two joined rectangular canvases carry black and white painted figure/ground forms. White wedges are painted ground, not transparent wall gaps; confirmed in the original plate and Bernstein essay, PDF54/printed44.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://archive.org/download/ellswo00kell/ellswo00kell.pdf#page=128; catalogue 27; visually inspected2026-10-27. Interpretive study, not facsimile.
